assets.prompt:
Use case: illustration-story
Asset type: wide interactive game stage background for the shrine courtyard leaf-gathering minigame
Input images: Image 1 is a style reference for this project's warm, detailed Japanese neighborhood environment; create a new close-up location, do not copy its layout.
Scene/backdrop: a quiet Japanese shrine courtyard in late autumn, stone paving, wooden veranda and a glimpse of vermilion architecture, distant maple trees in soft afternoon light.
Subject: a welcoming, tactile courtyard clearing where the player gathers fallen leaves.
Style/medium: polished painterly anime game background with crisp hand-painted detail, gentle filmic light, matching the supplied environment reference.
Composition/framing: wide 3:2 landscape; camera close to the ground at a slight angle; keep the central paving uncluttered so interactive leaves, basket and controls can be layered on top; detailed garden edges frame the scene.
Lighting/mood: golden afternoon, calm, warm and quietly magical.
Constraints: no people, no characters, no basket, no UI, no icons, no text, no symbols, no watermark.

Use case: illustration-story

Use case: illustration-story
